limitations: Low-level boc injected APIs and internal receipt check remain trusted module/test interfaces; raw privileged owner configure is not made inaccessible. Source hashes/provenance labels alone are not runtime authentication.
Coverage is full typed anchor plus actual typed16-byte mutex and their pages, not every opaque allocator/global/transitive object. No new opaque extent is guessed.
Two equal translation samples are not a future no-remap guarantee. Single-threaded boot ordering, resident code/control/context and complete platform policy remain prerequisites.
Public receipt copying is serialized, not an atomic multiword concurrent publication. Failure after successful configure is not rollback and must stop without retry.
Native effect backend remains absent; Step1 synthetic permission profile is not a prescription for actual DMA rights. No activation/exposed release/drain/continuous driver is admitted.
No runtime pin/configure/allocation, BootArgs integration, policy reader, module/KC/packet/service/deployment/boot or hardware result is established.
